glyph_origin: Oracle bone script: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 宀 (“house”) + 琡 (“jade”) + 貝 (“cowry”) – treasures in a house. The phonetic component 缶 was added to the character in bronze inscriptions.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 寶 (⿱珤貝 → 玉). Officially adopted as the simplified form of 寶 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
senses: [bǎo] treasure; riches; a wonder; valuables; precious thing
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 寶; s_page_origin explains the simplified 宝.
